system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The first writes a draft from the current code, the assigned sub-task, the starter contract, a compact summary of the previous relay state, and retrieved RAG context.
system_prompt_style.note: IDENTITY MISMATCH: the record names the Mars 'Induction from Reflection' agent (arXiv:2410.08126) with repo_url HarryYangthu/MARS-Multi-Agent-Research-System, but the pinned repository evidence is fckand/MARS (arXiv:2608.23918). This row codes the pinned fckand/MARS v1.0.0 relay. The prompts are in src/language_profiles.py, which was not in the evidence. Per-call variables suggest templated; with RAG and subtask inputs it could also be read as dynamically_composed.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: | Retrieval | local Qdrant index over algorithm-theory documents |
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval runs over the cp-algorithms corpus, not the task environment. The task is a self-contained problem statement.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The next specialist receives shared code and a compact relay summary, not the raw public-test report.
context_compaction.note: The summarizing code (_relay_step_with_agent) was not shown. It is unclear whether the summary is written by an LLM or by a heuristic.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The second call sees the report and returns one of keep-code, repair-code, or no-change together with structured hand-off fields.

tool_call_format.note: There are no tools. The model returns structured action, new_code and next_agent fields. The parser was not shown, so json_in_text is the closest value. Code is extracted from fenced blocks.

tool_count.evidence_quote: a prompt-only framework in which each agent is a topic specialist
tool_count.note: No tool schema is sent: requests carry only model, messages, temperature, top_p and max_tokens. src/base_smolagents.py was not inspected.

edit_primitive.note: The whole program is re-emitted as new_code. This is a model output field, not an edit tool.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schemas exist in the evidence (prompt-only system), and the schema source is not applicable.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Each request is a plain Chat Completions call carrying `model`, `messages`, `temperature`, `top_p`, and `max_tokens`; no server-specific fields are sent.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: A repair candidate is rerun on the public examples and accepted only if it compiles and does not reduce the number of passing public tests relative to that turn's draft
loop_primitives.note: The outer flow is select agents, then the relay loop, then sanitize, then infrastructure fixer (relay_loop.py:26-28). Each turn is draft, test, then repair or handoff.

planning_granularity.note: The subtask graph is stored and used to assign a subtask to each agent at every step.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a small team of task-matched agents is formed. The initial agent generates the candidate solution
multi_agent_topology.note: This is a relay of up to 3 specialists in which each one picks the next. pipeline is the closest value, but the order is chosen dynamically rather than fixed.

human_in_loop.note: The relay loop takes no human input. The system is a batch runner.

short_term_state.note: The state includes history, code_history, agent_call_counts, the subtask graph and the starter contract.

long_term_memory.note: The configuration surface shows only an agent-pool assessment cache and a static RAG index. No memory of past runs is re-injected.

state_persistence.note: The runner src/run_relay.py was not in the evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: each subsequent turn runs the candidate against public examples in a sandbox, lets the active specialist keep, repair, or hand off the draft
self_verification.note: The relay loop docstring mentions a 'passive judge sidecar' (src/judge.py). It was not inspected and is not coded as llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The relay is budget-bounded to at most three unique specialists and eight steps
retry_policy.note: There is one relay per task. Repair within a turn is step-level, not a task-level retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: otherwise the repair is rejected and the draft is restored.
rollback.note: The restore is an in-memory restore of the draft code, not a filesystem snapshot. snapshot is the closest value.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: stops on an explicit stop signal, when no unused selected specialist remains, at the step budget, or at a no-progress cutoff that reroutes at a streak of two and stops at three.

cost_controls.note: There is a per-call output cap only. No per-run cost or token budget is visible in config.py.

timeouts.note: The ExecEval client code and the timeout settings were not in the evidence.

execution_isolation.note: The local self-check compiles or runs py_compile, apparently on the host.

network_policy.note: The ExecEval launcher script was not shown.
